name: unsafe fn from_raw_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A) -> Self
rule: The caller of Rc<T, A>::from_raw_in(ptr, alloc) must ensure that a specific value of T is dropped at most once, even if the returned Rc<T, A> is never accessed.
api: impl < T : ? Sized , A : Allocator > alloc::rc::Rc < T , A > { unsafe fn from_raw_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A) -> Self }
expression: Not expressible in the supplied DSL: it has no observations for drop events or their count over time, including when the returned Rc is never accessed.
